title: ArcaneEnchants
description: Custom enchantments with lifesteal, auto-smelt and haste.
body:
# ArcaneEnchants

Custom enchantments with lifesteal, auto-smelt and haste.

## Features
- Lifesteal on weapon hits.
- Auto-smelt ores on block break.
- Haste while holding enchanted tools.
- Simple lore-based enchant storage.

## Command
- `/arcane give <player> <enchant> <level>`
- `/arcane list`
- `/arcane reload`

## Permissions
- `arcaneenchants.use`
- `arcaneenchants.admin`

## Compatibility
- Server: Paper, Spigot, Purpur
- Minecraft: 1.16.5 - 1.21.4
